meta.title: DCR — A Cargo-style build tool for C and C++
meta.description: DCR is a Cargo-style build tool and dependency manager for C and C++. One dcr.toml and a few simple commands: new, build, run, test.

hero.description: Build, run, and test C and C++ projects from a single dcr.toml, with dependencies managed for you. No Makefiles, no CMake scripts. Just dcr new, dcr build, and dcr run.

features.title: Features
lead: Everything you need to build C and C++.
One tool, one config, one workflow.

items.title: Simple commands
items.description: `new`, `build`, `run`, `test`, `clean`, `add`, `fmt`, `lint`: the whole workflow in one tool.

items.title: Path, Git, registry, and system dependencies
items.description: Use libraries from a local folder, a Git repository, a registry, or the system via `pkg-config`. `dcr.lock` records exactly what was resolved, including the Git commit.

items.title: Cross-compilation
items.description: Build for another OS or architecture from the same project. Set the target with a full target triple or a short name like `windows`.

items.title: Works with your IDE
items.description: `dcr gen` produces `compile_commands.json` and ready-made VS Code and CLion configs, so you can keep your editor.

items.title: One project file
items.description: Name, language, standard, compiler, and dependencies all live in `dcr.toml`, not scattered across scripts.

items.title: Built-in help
items.description: Every command has `--help`, and package installs include man pages such as `man dcr-build`.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.lead: Create and run a C or C++ project in three steps.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.description: `dcr new` sets up a project with a `dcr.toml` and a ready-to-build `src/main.c`.

steps.title: Configure
steps.description: Describe the project in one short, readable TOML file. No CMake syntax required.

steps.title: Build and run
steps.description: `dcr run` builds the project and its dependencies, then runs the result.

cta.question: Need custom compiler flags, Qt support, or a bare-metal build?

download.title: Download
download.lead: Install DCR with a single command.
download.note: The installer also sets up dcrup, a version manager for DCR.
